description: This file defines custom Google Mock matchers and operator overloads for comparing specific data structures used in the Rialto server project, such as Rectangle and Fraction, and includes utility matchers for string and array comparisons.

methods.name: operator== (Rectangle)
methods.description: Equality operator for Rectangle objects, used for comparisons in tests.

methods.name: operator== (Fraction)
methods.description: Equality operator for Fraction objects, used for comparisons in tests.

methods.name: CharStrMatcher
methods.description: Custom matcher to compare a string argument with an expected string.

methods.name: NotNullMatcher
methods.description: Custom matcher to verify that a pointer argument is not null.

methods.name: arrayMatcher
methods.description: Custom matcher to compare a byte array against a vector of expected bytes.
